svg.title: Sequence - approval and learning loop
svg.text: Sequence: human approval and the learning loop
UC-17.2 (issue on approval), UC-17.3 (confirm fix) and UC-17.4 (negative feedback). Nothing is written without a recorded human approval.
A · Recurring failure → issue (execute on approval)
B · Confirm fix → learn (execute on approval)
20. role check + find the fixing MR
Approval rules: commenter must be Developer or higher; approvals are single-use,
expire after 7 days, and are checked again by mcp-knowledge (defence in depth).
The run is excluded from the knowledge base and added to the next eval review list.
